subject: SIG: Access controls evidence & SCIM implementation checklist for CloudFrame
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cloudframe.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cloudframe.com
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: initial access controls responses attached

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for sending over the SIG. We did a first pass on the access control (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA) section and attached our worksheet. High level notes:
- We use SAML SSO via Okta for user auth; assertion includes groups.
- SCIM is enabled for provisioning but currently maps teams to a single group per app; we can provide the SCIM export.
- RBAC is implemented at the application layer with roles: Admin, Manager, Analyst; least-privilege is enforced for API keys.
- MFA is enforced for all user accounts in Okta (push + TOTP fallback).

We're attaching the SIG_AccessResponses_CloudFrame_20271001.xlsx and a small SCIM export for the app. Let us know which evidence artifacts you still need (logs, screenshots, or configuration exports).

Best,
Alice Chen
Security Operations Lead
CloudFrame

Attachments:
- SIG_AccessResponses_CloudFrame_20271001.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- scim_config_export_20271001.json (text)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cloudframe.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial access controls responses attached

Thanks Alice — this is a great start. A couple of clarifying asks from our side so we can close the SIG access controls section: 

1) SCIM mapping: can you confirm whether you provision users with 'active' state only and whether you sync group membership delta or full sync? We need the cadence and filtering rules. A SCIM delta log or a recent export is ideal.
2) SAML assertions: can you share a sample (redacted) SAML response showing group claims and the NameID format? A screenshot of the Okta app sign-on settings + metadata.xml is acceptable.
3) RBAC enforcement: for API tokens referenced in the spreadsheet, please provide the policy document or an example role binding that shows least privilege for 'Analyst' vs 'Admin'.
4) MFA exception handling: do you have a documented exception/temporary access process (e.g., helpdesk override) and logs for the last 90 days showing exception events?

If it's easier, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week with our Trust Engineering team to review a live SCIM export and SAML config. Monica — looping you for availability to own the walkthrough scheduling and to collect the artifacts.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

[redwood_ssomatrix_diagram.png referenced]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cloudframe.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial access controls responses attached

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround. I'm booking time for the walkthrough: 2027-10-06 10:00 PST / 13:00 EST. Please confirm. For the artifacts, attaching a checklist of the minimum items we need so our Compliance team can sign off after the call: 

Checklist for post-call upload (preferred formats in parentheses):
- SCIM: recent full export + delta log if available (JSON)
- SAML: metadata XML + redacted SAML response screenshot (XML / PNG)
- RBAC: role definitions & sample policy for Analyst/Admin (PDF or MD)
- MFA: policy doc & exception log (CSV)
- Evidence of least privilege: one example provisioning request showing scoped permissions (PDF)

If any of these items are controlled by your IdP team and require redaction, a screenshot with the metadata.org endpoint and a copy of the attribute mapping will suffice. Laura — could you prepare the one-page evidence intake template we promised to customers?

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: redwood_evidence_intake_template_v1.docx

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cloudframe.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Rivera <bob.rivera@cloudframe.com>, security@cloudframe.com
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial access controls responses attached

Hi Monica, Dylan — confirmed for 2027-10-06 10:00 PST. We'll bring a SCIM export and an Okta metadata XML (redacted) to the call. Quick answers inline before the meeting so you can pre-check: 

- SCIM: we currently do full sync nightly; delta sync is enabled for enterprise customers but not yet in our staging config. We'll provide the full export and a sample delta from a test tenant.
- SAML: NameID uses email address; groups are sent as a 'groups' attribute (CSV). We will provide a redacted sample response and the Okta app metadata.
- RBAC: role bindings are stored in our policy service; attaching a short PDF example for Analyst and Admin roles. Analyst cannot create or delete API keys; Admin can.
- MFA exceptions: we have a documented temporary access flow requiring manager approval and a ticket in our helpdesk. We'll export exception tickets for the last 90 days and redact PII.

We'll upload the requested artifacts to the shared Drive link after the call and send a DocuSign attestation for our internal security owner to sign. Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Alice Chen
Security Operations Lead
CloudFrame

Attachments to upload after call (expected): scim_config_export_20271002.json, okta_metadata_redacted.xml, rbacs_sample_policy_20271003.pdf, mfa_exception_log_202707-202709.csv
